decision_rules.200_checkpoint: descriptive only: report200-100 and300-200 signs/intervals; no monotonicity gate or checkpoint selection
decision_rules.V2_question_separate: positive300-100 is learning relative to100, not proof of outperforming V2; report d300 and its map interval separately
decision_rules.no_supported_improvement: report each seed and pooled conditional map interval; nonpositive curves do not identify a causal algorithm defect
decision_rules.strong_consistent_learning_signal: all three mean300-100 differences positive and map-bootstrap CI for their mapwise average entirely positive; descriptive evidence conditional on3 training RNGs

interpretation: Registered development roots, not final holdout; three training RNGs reported separately; old IL400 roots missing; 480 games form24 map clusters, not480 independent maps

mean_of_three_training_seeds.interpretation: Conditional on these three fitted training seeds. Map-cluster interval does not quantify training-seed population uncertainty.

metric.not_big_game_wdl_points: Big-game W/D/L is sign of this difference, a separate -1/0/1 statistic
metric.not_team_points: team_points resets each mini-match and is zero at task end; no cumulative resource-point margin is claimed
